newsitem.title: USA: Florida judge drops case against mother.
newsitem.headline: Florida judge drops case against mother.

text.p: - A Florida judge who threatened to jail a mother for refusing to tell her son his father is a convicted murderer said Thursday he would drop the case, citing publicity it has received.

"The public spectacle has intertwined this judge's name to such a degree that the apperance of personal bias could always exist in any future evidentiary hearing," Circuit Judge Patrick Kennedy said in a statement announcing he was withdrawing the case.
The decision was a victory for Kim Spradley, who waged a media battle with Kennedy.

He had ordered her to tell her son Justin, 7, that his father was John Taylor, convicted of killing Spradley's room-mate 6 years ago in what police believed was intended to be an attack on Spradley. Taylor is serving a 50-year prison sentence.
Kennedy threatened to jail Spradly on contempt charges if she did not comply.
"This is a nice Christmas present," Spradley said after his statement on Thursday. "For now I don't have worry about being away from my family and my children."
The conflict over whether the child knew the identity of his biological father occurred as a result of a suit filed by Taylor's suit visitation rights.
He demanded that Justin be taken for regular visits to Ocala, Florida, where he is incarcerated. He also wants some control over how his son is raised.
